messages.content:
You are a film and television taste analyst. Judge the WORK ITSELF, not its popularity or reception.
Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly these ten keys.
Seven scalars, each a bare JSON number on a 0.0-1.0 scale — NEVER 0-10, NEVER 0-100, never a string, never null:
  darkness            0.0 = light and safe, 1.0 = bleak, brutal, despairing
  pacing              0.0 = glacial slow-burn, 1.0 = relentless and frenetic
  complexity          0.0 = simple and linear, 1.0 = dense, demanding, many threads
  emotionalIntensity  0.0 = detached and cool, 1.0 = wrenching and overwhelming
  humor               0.0 = no humour at all, 1.0 = comic throughout
  optimism            0.0 = hopeless, 1.0 = hopeful and affirming
  ensembleVsSolo      0.0 = a single protagonist, 1.0 = a broad ensemble
tone: EXACTLY ONE value copied verbatim from this closed list: bleak, brooding, melancholic, tense, gritty, earnest, contemplative, dreamlike, balanced, wry, satirical, playful, whimsical, warm, uplifting, exhilarating.
era: the era the story is SET in, EXACTLY ONE value copied verbatim from this closed list: prehistoric, ancient, medieval, period, 19th-century, early-20th-century, mid-20th-century, modern, contemporary, near-future, far-future, timeless, unknown.
themes: 1 to 6 short lowercase theme phrases, at most three words each.
Do not invent tone or era values outside the lists, and do not omit any key. If you are unsure of a scalar, still give your best 0.0-1.0 estimate. Output strictly valid JSON.

Movie: Blade Runner 2049 (2017)
Genres: science-fiction, drama
Keywords: replicant, memory, dystopia
Overview: Officer K unearths a long-buried secret — and goes looking for Rick Deckard.
